subject: A small company selling a mixing-console audio plugin for music producers.
techniques: SC5 word illumination, HV12 meter-glass glare, CD9 tabs crossfade, MI6
built_motion: Desk power-up load (LD8 chrome, knob recall, lamp test in signal order). Signature: a Nordic PPM (IEC 60268-10 Type I) lines up: the meter lamp warms on a smooth CustomEase, 0.3 s into the warm-up the needle snaps to Test and holds there 0.6 s as on a 1 kHz line-up tone, then falls 20 dB per 1.7 s; a peak-hold mark keeps the highest peak of the last two bars. The needle then reads the live Web Audio loop. No VU, no overshoot (crud-vet-clinic keeps that).

subject: Licence tiers for a historical photo archive that licenses images to publishers.
techniques: CU2 list preview follows cursor, HV9 expanding rows, CD8 hold to confirm
built_motion: Signature: plates held to the light. The open plate widens in the rack (HV9 as one clip-path and x proxy per plate, picture offset derived from the clip) and develops from negative to sepia positive with one keyframed filter tween over 1.1s: lift to --flare-neg (0.3, power2.in), flip to --flare-pos (0.1, linear), build density to --pos (0.6, power2.out); the flare keeps most contrast so the drawing never flattens to grey. Closing plates re-invert over 0.6s power2.inOut. Load: plate 1 arrives open with terms readable by about 0.6s and develops from 0.8s. Scroll: ledger rules draw (SC16), plate rises from its sleeve (scrub). NV4/NV6 nav. CU2 cursor preview and CD8 hold-to-confirm were dropped (hold belongs to contact-recording-studio and cta-vineyard-harvest); ledger rows dim siblings (HV7) with a keyboard equivalent.
